topic: T2_A_shape - Signal A depths, radius and shape tests (VERIFIER)
summary: Most of the reconciler's result stands. I read every cited key, re-derived the depth sets, the k statistics and the sign conventions (verify/v01_checks.py -> verify/out/v01_checks.json), and read the codes that produced them (s09_events.py, s10_eb_tests.py, s08_globalfit.py, s04_tests.py, leo_vetter main.py). The phase-0.5 value is a box DEPTH: s10 L42 computes 1 - weighted mean flux, so the printed 'depth -20 +- 32 ppm' is correct. Four items are corrected. (1) A.k / X-U-02: S98 epoch -1 does not only inflate the high end of k. Excluding it changes k by -0.00033 (raw) and +0.00069 (biweight), so it drives both ends. All-23 fits give a mean k of 0.0203 (SD 0.0006, range 0.0195-0.0212); the adopted value should be 0.0204 +- 0.0010, not +- 0.0008, with Rp = 1.39 +- 0.08. (2) A.S6_effect: 'within 0.5 sigma of the quoted values' holds only for the raw-flux no-S6 fit. (3) A.S6_use: S6 does contribute to T14 and the V/U test. (4) X-A-13: S6 depth agreement is specific to PDCSAP (paired SAP-PDCSAP difference +158 +- 69 ppm).

The note should say the range is 514-536 across six estimates: U07 biweight tests_results.json depths.S6 = 536.0 was omitted.

The empirical error of 75 is justified: the audit's own per-event chi2 of a constant for S32 is 16.8 for 7 dof, so the beta-covariance 52 is too small (52 x sqrt(16.8/7) = 81). U07 raw 475.3 +- 77.2, R-S6 480.5 +- 76.4 and verify 445 +- 74 were read back.

503.37 +- 29.17 is reproduced exactly from the s09 rows, and 497.6 +- 29.4 without epoch -1. The s17 all-sector means are 490.3-510.7. The free-dt bias is 3.8-5.2% per sector (injection mean_D / injected median: S6 1.038, S32 1.052, S98 1.049). '~500 ppm' is right for the template mid-transit depth.

s10 L141-161: V = trapezoid with x = 0.5, U with x free. dchi2 = (chi2_V - chi2_U)/scale, positive = V worse; 31.84, scale 1.062. The r02 code was read: exposure-integrated trapezoid vs triangle, three noise treatments; the log matches r02_vshape.json. The bootstrap used 300 draws (log n=300), not the 400 in the docstring; this does not affect the p2.5 values (17.2-23.1). The printed form 'Delta chi2 = 32; >= 21 allowing for red noise' is supported.

verdicts.corrected_value: Like-for-like refits without S6 (R-S6): raw k -0.21 sigma, b +0.32, T14 -0.55, Rp -0.15; biweight k -0.78, T14 -0.61, Rp -0.56; phase-0.5 depth 0.64-0.81 sigma; all < 1 sigma. Against the revised manuscript values (k 0.021+-0.001, b 0.35, T14 1.87+-0.05), the raw no-S6 fit is within 0.5 sigma (k -0.17, b +0.11, T14 -0.27; edge-excluded k -0.50, T14 -0.46). The biweight no-S6 fit is NOT: T14 -0.60 sigma and k -1.34 sigma, the latter mostly a detrending offset already present with S6 (-0.86 sigma).
verdicts.reason: The fact text says 'every no-S6 value is within 0.5 sigma' of the quoted values. That holds only for the raw-flux reduction. The recommended '<1 sigma' wording is right.

verdicts.corrected_value: S6 PDCSAP is usable for depth, timing and the joint shape fit (x15 exposure integration everywhere) and unusable for difference images. It is not negligible for shape: dropping it moves T14 by -0.52 to -0.61 sigma and lowers the V/U Delta chi2 from 37 to 28. Its depth is product-dependent (paired SAP - PDCSAP = +158 +- 69 ppm over 6 events; own TESScut 653, eleanor 857, TGLC 982 ppm), so S6 depth agreement holds for PDCSAP only.
verdicts.reason: 'b, T14 and the V/U test are set by S32+S98' is contradicted by the same R-S6 outputs. The PDCSAP-only caveat was missing from this fact.

verdicts.corrected_value: Depth part: the S6 TESS-SPOC PDCSAP depth (523 +- 58) agrees with S32+S98 (500 +- 45) and does not change with dump masking (486-543). The agreement is product-specific: TESS-SPOC SAP is deeper by +158 +- 69 ppm in a paired per-event comparison (2.3 sigma), and FFI photometries give 653-982 ppm. S6 confirms A in timing/period robustly; its depth confirms A only for PDCSAP.
verdicts.reason: The resolution 'S6 photometry agrees with S32+S98' is too general. It is true for PDCSAP; the stored SAP/eleanor/TGLC/own depths disagree, and the cause has not been demonstrated.

As for A.Vshape. U07 beta 21.21 and the biweight S98 beta of 1.62 (1.35 without epoch -1) were read back.

The diagnosis 'the high end is driven by epoch -1' is incomplete: epoch -1 also sets the low end (biweight -234 ppm; excluding it raises k by 0.0005-0.0007). The all-23 fits centre on 0.0203 as well, so the adopted centre does not depend on excluding the event. 0.021 +- 0.001 is off-centre by 0.6 sigma.
'<1 sigma' holds for every like-for-like change (max |0.81| sigma, phase-0.5). The 'against quoted values' clause is qualified in A.S6_effect.

missed.what: Quantified S6 depth product dependence (paired test)
missed.why_it_matters: 'Per-sector depths agree' and 'S6 confirms A' rest on PDCSAP. TESS-SPOC SAP from the same pixels is deeper by +158 +- 69 ppm per event (2.3 sigma). At 700 ppm, S6 would disagree with S32+S98 at about 2.5 sigma. A referee comparing products would ask.
missed.suggested_value: S6 SAP - PDCSAP = +158 +- 69 ppm (6 paired events); keep the Note wording (products are named in Sec. 1); record as open.

missed.what: Secondary-eclipse limits at phases other than 0.5
missed.why_it_matters: Sec. 4 leaves an eccentric orbit (e >~ 0.2-0.6) around a bound companion as the open scenario. An eccentric secondary need not fall at phase 0.5. The phase-0.5 limit alone does not address it; the stored scans do.
missed.suggested_value: Two-sided-baseline scan (width T14): no dip beyond 1.7 sigma (min -61 ppm at phase 0.59, robust SD 37 ppm), i.e. no secondary deeper than about 110 ppm (3 sigma) at any phase. Optional; the '4.2 sigma' dip at phase 0.368 without two-sided baselines is spurious.

missed.what: U07 biweight S6 depth omitted from the S6 range
missed.why_it_matters: The claim that all codes give 514-523 ppm is incomplete.
